answer: Each PoA agent identity uses a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) as its anchor, and is paired with hardware-protected keys whose attestation proves that the measured code executes on genuine Intel SGX or AMD SEV infrastructure. Freshness checks prevent replay, while altered images and software-only duplicates fail verification. Thus, creating another valid identity requires additional trusted physical silicon, not merely cloning a VM across an ocean of hosts or onto cloud terrace.
